title: Show Trending Search Suggestions
description: Learn how to enable and customize trending search suggestions in Oasis's awesome bar, understand how they work, and discover how to manage your search experience for enhanced browsing.
content:
Oasis browser's awesome bar includes trending search suggestions that help you discover popular topics and current events as you type. These suggestions are powered by search engines and provide real-time insights into what people are searching for around the world. Understanding how trending search suggestions work and how to customize them can enhance your browsing experience and help you stay informed about trending topics.

Pro Tip

Trending search suggestions can help you discover breaking news, popular topics, and current events. They're designed to enhance your search experience while respecting your privacy preferences.

What Are Trending Search Suggestions?

Trending search suggestions are real-time recommendations that appear in your browser's address bar (awesome bar) as you type. These suggestions are based on:

Current Events

Trending suggestions reflect what's happening now:

  • Breaking News: Latest news stories and developments
  • Popular Topics: Currently trending subjects and discussions
  • Seasonal Events: Holidays, sports events, and cultural moments
  • Viral Content: Popular videos, memes, and social media trends

Search Patterns

Suggestions based on collective search behavior:

  • Global Trends: What people worldwide are searching for
  • Regional Interest: Popular searches in your geographic area
  • Category Trends: Trending topics in specific categories
  • Real-time Updates: Suggestions that update throughout the day

How Trending Suggestions Work

Data Sources

Trending suggestions are powered by multiple sources:

  • Search Engines: Google, Bing, and other search providers
  • Social Media: Trending topics from social platforms
  • News Sources: Current events and breaking news
  • Regional Data: Location-based trending information

Privacy Protection

How your privacy is protected with trending suggestions:

  • No Personal Data: Suggestions don't use your personal search history
  • Aggregated Data: Based on anonymous, aggregated search patterns
  • No Tracking: Your individual searches aren't tracked for suggestions
  • User Control: You can disable trending suggestions entirely

Real-time Updates

How suggestions stay current:

  • Live Updates: Suggestions refresh throughout the day
  • Event-driven: Respond to breaking news and events
  • Algorithm Updates: Continuously improved suggestion algorithms
  • Quality Filtering: Filtered for relevance and appropriateness

Enabling Trending Search Suggestions

Accessing Settings

To enable trending search suggestions in Oasis:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Navigate to the "Search" section
  3. Find "Address Bar" or "Awesome Bar" settings
  4. Look for "Trending Search Suggestions" or similar option
  5. Toggle the setting to enable trending suggestions

Alternative Method

You can also access these settings through:

  1. Type about:preferences#search in the address bar
  2. Scroll to the "Address Bar" section
  3. Find trending search suggestion options
  4. Enable or customize the feature

Browser Restart

After enabling trending suggestions:

  • Restart Required: Some changes may require restarting Oasis
  • Immediate Effect: Most settings take effect immediately
  • Testing: Try typing in the address bar to see suggestions
  • Verification: Check that trending suggestions appear as expected

Customizing Trending Suggestions

Suggestion Categories

Choose which types of trending suggestions to see:

  • News and Current Events: Breaking news and political developments
  • Entertainment: Movies, TV shows, celebrities, and pop culture
  • Sports: Sports events, teams, and athletic news
  • Technology: Tech news, gadgets, and software updates
  • Business and Finance: Market news, companies, and economic trends

Regional Preferences

Customize suggestions for your location:

  • Global Trends: See worldwide trending topics
  • Local Trends: Focus on trends in your country or region
    • Language Preferences: Choose your preferred language for suggestions
  • Cultural Relevance: Suggestions relevant to your cultural context

Display Options

Control how trending suggestions appear:

  • Suggestion Count: Choose how many suggestions to show
  • Update Frequency: How often suggestions refresh
  • Display Format: Text-only or with icons/thumbnails
  • Positioning: Where suggestions appear in the dropdown

Using Trending Search Suggestions

How to Use Suggestions

Making the most of trending search suggestions:

  • Click to Search: Click on any suggestion to search for that topic
  • Keyboard Navigation: Use arrow keys to navigate suggestions
  • Enter to Select: Press Enter to select the highlighted suggestion
  • Ignore Suggestions: Continue typing to ignore suggestions

Discovering Content

How suggestions help you discover new content:

  • Breaking News: Stay informed about current events
  • Popular Topics: Discover what others are interested in
  • Entertainment: Find trending movies, shows, and celebrities
  • Educational Content: Learn about trending educational topics

Search Efficiency

How suggestions improve your search experience:

  • Faster Searching: Quick access to popular search terms
  • Better Results: Trending terms often yield better search results
  • Time Saving: No need to type out long search queries
  • Discovery: Find content you might not have searched for

Privacy and Data Considerations

Data Collection

What data is collected for trending suggestions:

  • Aggregated Searches: Anonymous search patterns from many users
  • Geographic Data: General location for regional trends
  • Language Preferences: Your preferred language settings
  • No Personal History: Your individual search history is not used

Privacy Protection

How your privacy is maintained:

  • Anonymous Data: No personally identifiable information collected
  • Local Processing: Some processing happens locally on your device
  • User Control: You can disable the feature entirely
  • Transparent Policies: Clear information about data usage
Privacy Note

Trending search suggestions are designed with privacy in mind. They use aggregated, anonymous data and don't track your individual search behavior. You have full control over whether to enable this feature.

Disabling Trending Suggestions

How to Disable

To turn off trending search suggestions:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Go to the "Search" section
  3. Find "Address Bar" or "Awesome Bar" settings
  4. Locate "Trending Search Suggestions"
  5. Toggle the setting to disable
  6. Restart Oasis if prompted

Alternative Disabling Methods

Other ways to disable trending suggestions:

  • Address Bar Method: Type about:preferences#search in the address bar
  • Privacy Settings: Check privacy settings for search-related options
  • Search Engine Settings: Modify settings for your default search engine
  • Extension Control: Use privacy extensions to block suggestions

What Happens When Disabled

Effects of disabling trending suggestions:

  • No Trending Content: You won't see trending search suggestions
  • Personal Suggestions: May still see suggestions based on your history
  • Manual Searching: You'll need to type search terms manually
  • Privacy Enhancement: Reduced data collection for suggestions

Troubleshooting Trending Suggestions

Common Issues

Problems you might encounter with trending suggestions:

  • No Suggestions Appearing: Trending suggestions not showing up
  • Outdated Suggestions: Suggestions seem stale or irrelevant
  • Performance Issues: Browser slowdown with suggestions enabled
  • Inappropriate Content: Suggestions that don't match your preferences

Solutions

How to resolve trending suggestion issues:

  1. Check Settings: Verify trending suggestions are enabled
  2. Clear Cache: Clear browser cache and cookies
  3. Update Browser: Ensure you're using the latest version of Oasis
  4. Check Internet Connection: Ensure stable internet connection
  5. Restart Browser: Restart Oasis to apply changes
  6. Contact Support: Reach out to Mozilla support if issues persist

Performance Optimization

Optimizing performance with trending suggestions:

  • Limit Suggestions: Reduce the number of suggestions shown
  • Update Frequency: Lower the frequency of suggestion updates
  • Disable When Needed: Turn off during heavy browsing sessions
  • Monitor Performance: Watch for any performance impact

Best Practices

Privacy Best Practices

Maintaining privacy while using trending suggestions:

  • Review Settings: Regularly review your suggestion preferences
  • Use Privacy Mode: Consider using private browsing for sensitive searches
  • Clear Data Regularly: Clear search data periodically
  • Monitor Permissions: Check what permissions the feature requires

Usage Best Practices

Getting the most out of trending suggestions:

  • Stay Informed: Use suggestions to discover current events
  • Explore Topics: Click on interesting suggestions to learn more
  • Customize Preferences: Adjust settings to match your interests
  • Combine with Bookmarks: Use suggestions alongside your bookmarks

Content Quality

Ensuring high-quality suggestion content:

  • Verify Information: Check multiple sources for trending topics
  • Be Critical: Evaluate the credibility of trending content
  • Report Issues: Report inappropriate or misleading suggestions
  • Stay Updated: Keep your browser updated for better filtering

Additional Resources

For more information about trending search suggestions, we recommend:

Mozilla Trending Searches Guide - Official guide from Mozilla

Firefox Awesome Bar Documentation - Complete awesome bar guide

Search Suggestions Guide - Information about search suggestions

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis's trending search suggestions feature. The functionality and privacy practices described are specific to Oasis's approach. Other browsers may have different trending suggestion features, privacy policies, and customization options.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it shares similar awesome bar features and can benefit from Mozilla's trending search suggestion capabilities.
